prompt: Summarize the following meeting notes in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: In the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project, attendees outlined a three-phase rollout starting with discovery in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, with a decision gate afterward. Action items were assigned to confirm coordinator assignments and refine the project proposal.
